From: Alter, Marlowe <malter@freepress.com>

Subject: RE: Next few weeks 
 
Thanks. Enjoy man.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Saturday, October 12, 2019 2:01 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>; Alter, Marlowe <malter@freepress.com>; Ford, Ryan <rford@freepress.com>
Subject: Next few weeks
Hey guys, I’m going off the grid until Nov. 5. I don’t expect there to be much news besides possibly a few minor roster moves after the World Series.
If something calamitous happens, like Ilitch selling the team or someone dying or the like, feel free to contact me, but I’m going to be out of pocket.
Thank you for the help this season.

Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
